I rent this small plot, just under a quarter hectare, and I plant beans with some maize between the rows like my neighbors do here in Kagera. I do not have cash to buy fertilizer from the shop — beans also do not need it much, they feed themselves from the soil, that is what my mother always told me. I will save my little money for good bean seed from last season's harvest and maybe some manure from my neighbor who keeps a cow. The rains come twice here so I do not need to water, and I will weed myself with my hoe.
